async def act(page):
    """
    Add a simple product named "Lelelumon Yoga Mat" with 42 in stock,
    available in size uni-size and color black, price $769.99.

    Notes about knowledge base functions: there are no helper functions available
    in the provided knowledge base for this site, so this routine uses Playwright
    page interactions directly.
    """
    import asyncio

    # Helper utilities to try multiple possible selectors/labels.
    async def try_click_role(role, name, timeout=2000):
        try:
            await page.get_by_role(role, name=name).click(timeout=timeout)
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False

    async def try_fill_textbox(names, value):
        """Try filling the first textbox matching any of the names (case-insensitive substring)."""
        for n in names:
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("textbox", name=n).fill(value)
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
        return False

    async def try_select_combobox(names, option_label):
        """Try selecting option_label from a combobox with any of the provided names."""
        for n in names:
            try:
                cb = page.get_by_role("combobox", name=n)
                # select_option expects the option value or label; try by label
                await cb.select_option(label=option_label)
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
        return False

    async def try_fill_any(names, value):
        """Try filling either a textbox or spinbutton for the given names."""
        for n in names:
            try:
                locator = page.get_by_role("textbox", name=n)
                await locator.fill(value)
                return True
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                locator = page.get_by_role("spinbutton", name=n)
                await locator.fill(value)
                return True
            except Exception:
                pass
        return False

    # 1) Go directly to the new product creation page (relative goto)
    #    This avoids clicking the top-level Catalog link which would navigate away.
    await page.goto("/index.php/admin/catalog_product/new/")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)

    # 2) If the initial page shows the attribute set / product type chooser, choose "Simple Product"
    #    and continue. Try to click typical button labels.
    await try_click_role("button", "Simple Product")
    await try_click_role("button", "Continue")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(800)

    # 3) Fill the basic required product info: Name, SKU, Price
    await try_fill_textbox(["Name", "Product Name", "name"], "Lelelumon Yoga Mat")
    # SKU: if Magento auto-generates SKU, still attempt to set explicit SKU.
    await try_fill_textbox(["SKU", "sku"], "LELELUMON-YOGA-MAT")
    # Price
    await try_fill_textbox(["Price", "price"], "769.99")

    # 4) Set status to Enabled (if such a selector exists)
    # Try combobox or button labeled "Status" / options "Enabled"
    await try_select_combobox(["Status", "status"], "Enabled")

    # 5) Set visibility to "Catalog, Search" or at least "Catalog"
    await try_select_combobox(["Visibility", "visibility"], "Catalog, Search")
    await try_select_combobox(["Visibility", "visibility"], "Catalog")

    # 6) Set configurable attributes: Color and Size
    # Try common label names and option labels (case-insensitive attempts via exact labels)
    await try_select_combobox(["Color", "color"], "Black")
    await try_select_combobox(["Color", "color"], "black")
    await try_select_combobox(["Size", "size"], "uni-size")
    await try_select_combobox(["Size", "size"], "Uni-Size")
    await try_select_combobox(["Size", "size"], "Uni Size")

    # 7) Configure Inventory: set Qty to 42 and set Stock Availability / In Stock
    # Open Inventory tab if present
    await try_click_role("tab", "Inventory")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
    # Fill quantity in variant field names
    await try_fill_any(["Qty", "Quantity", "qty"], "42")
    # Set stock availability if there is a combobox or radio
    await try_select_combobox(["Stock Availability", "Stock", "is_in_stock"], "In Stock")

    # 8) Assign to website/store views: try selecting "All Store Views" if applicable
    await try_select_combobox(["Choose Store View:", "Store View", "store view"], "All Store Views")

    # 9) Save the product. This click is expected to navigate away / submit the form, so make it the last action.
    # Try common Save button labels.
    # Use the full path if Save button is inside a form region; try several heuristics.
    saved = False
    for save_label in ["Save", "Save and Continue Edit", "Save Product", "Save Item"]:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name=save_label).click()
            saved = True
            break
        except Exception:
            continue

    if not saved:
        # As a fallback, try clicking a button with role=button and name contains "Save"
        try:
            # locate any button with name containing Save
            buttons = page.get_by_role("button")
            count = await buttons.count()
            for i in range(count):
                try:
                    btn = buttons.nth(i)
                    text = await btn.inner_text()
                    if "save" in text.lower():
                        await btn.click()
                        saved = True
                        break
                except Exception:
                    continue
        except Exception:
            pass

    # If saved is True, the form submission/navigation has been triggered and this is the last action.
    # If we did not find a Save button, we leave the page as-is.
    return
